answer: Give every identity a pulse: a signed heartbeat chained to the latest block hash, which cannot be backdated, since that hash only existed then. Weight comes from relic credentials, attestations earned through long honest work that decay whenever an agent goes silent. A sybil farm starts at the nadir: zero relic weight, and each fake must sustain an unbroken pulse chain for many epochs to gain any. One missed pulse resets that identity to the nadir, so faking a hundred identities means a hundred pulse streams running for weeks, while one honest agent pulses cheaply as part of normal work.
